name: Cancellation of all ultraviolet divergences of quantum gravity by a scale-invariant gas of branes (theorem, every order of perturbation theory, n >= 4)
target: Gravity whose graviton kinetic operator is multiplied by the form factor of a frozen scale-invariant Poisson gas of branes, exp[(n/2) Ein(Box^2/M^4)] times the random factor of one realization under the fine-graining condition (G), has no ultraviolet divergence at any order of perturbation theory for n >= 4, with Newton's constant and the cosmological constant not running and a unitary physical S matrix
result: The manuscript claims perturbative ultraviolet finiteness under its brane, vertex, subtraction and one-loop tuning assumptions. The audit reproduced 195 numerical checks, the exact pole matrix and all 17 auxiliary Lean arithmetic theorems after compiler-compatibility repairs. Negative overall degree at two or more loops does not remove one-loop subdivergences; those require subtraction. The quoted vacuum value uses dimensional regularization or matched asymptotic subtraction and is not the raw value for every cutoff. The full all-order BRST and unitarity audit remains separate; no interacting nonperturbative construction is supplied.

notes.formal: All 17 auxiliary arithmetic theorems freshly re-elaborated with Lean 4.34.1; axioms propext and Quot.sound only. Compiler-compatibility copy in paper/poisson-bridge/. The analytic and field-theoretic claims are not formalised.
notes.code: 195 Python, 84 C and 114 Julia checks and five independent audit scripts in the repository; the constructions are rebuilt here in construct/brane_formfactor.py
notes.risk: the paper states the limits: not reflection positive, strongly coupled above about 1.4 M to 1.9 M, nothing beyond perturbation theory
notes.human: Not certified as refereed; journal submission status was not independently verified in this audit.

barriers: beyond perturbation theory: the free Euclidean field is not reflection positive for any entire non-constant form factor without zeros, so the Osterwalder-Schrader route cannot give a positive-metric theory
the Euclidean conformal mode is unbounded below, as in general relativity
the loop expansion is large above an energy between 1.4 M and 1.9 M; Borel summability is not proved and complex poles of the resummed propagator are excluded only in the region Omega
